(6) The man and woman are seen walking across a glass-railed bridge, talking enthusiastically to the camera. (7) The setting transitions to another clothing store, 'Roots', where the camera pans across a rack of white and lavender hoodies. (8) A final close-up shows a white hoodie's price tag being held by a hand with black-painted nails, revealing a price of 3980.00.
